description: This file implements core domain logic for managing exam flows, including starting attempts, fetching questions, and submitting answers. It defines data classes for results, utility functions for validation and data loading, and primary functions for exam attempt lifecycle management. The code interacts heavily with SQLAlchemy ORM models and enforces exam rules such as single attempt per user per module, answer correctness evaluation, and attempt status updates.

classes.name: ExamStartResult
classes.description: Holds the result data when starting an exam attempt, including attempt ID, module ID, start and expiry times, duration, and status.

classes.name: ExamQuestionsResult
classes.description: Contains the questions for an exam attempt, including module ID, attempt ID, and question details.

classes.name: ExamSubmitResult
classes.description: Represents the outcome after submitting an exam attempt, including scoring details and correctness mapping.

methods.name: uuid.UUID _require_uuid(value: str, field: str)
methods.description: Validates and converts a string to a UUID, raising a DomainError if invalid.

methods.name: Exam _load_exam_by_module(session: Session, module_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Loads an Exam model instance associated with a given module UUID.

methods.name: dict[str,list[str]] _compute_correct_map(session: Session, question_ids: list[uuid.UUID])
methods.description: Generates a mapping from question IDs to correct choice IDs based on database data.

methods.name: bool _is_multi_select(session: Session, question_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Determines if a question allows multiple correct answers.

methods.name: ExamStartResult start_exam_attempt_flow(*, session: Session, user_id: str, module_id: str)
methods.description: Initiates a new exam attempt for a user on a specified module, enforcing single attempt rule and creating related progress records.

methods.name: ExamQuestionsResult get_exam_questions_flow(*, session: Session, user_id: str, module_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches questions for an in-progress attempt, with fallbacks to module questions if necessary.

methods.name: ExamSubmitResult submit_exam_attempt_flow( *, session: Session, user_id: str, module_id: str, attempt_id: str, answers_by_question_id: dict[str, list[str]], )
methods.description: Processes exam answers, evaluates correctness, updates attempt and progress status atomically, and returns scoring data.
